 About Erik Lambrechts
 CountryBelgium
 Recorded matches142
 Available seasons2022/2023 – 2026/2027
 Competitions11
 Erik Lambrechts, born on September 17, 1984 in Leuven, Belgium, is a Belgian football referee who has gained recognition in national and international competitions. He began his career in the Belgian Pro League and has been part of the FIFA referees panel since 2014. In the 2024/2025 season, Lambrechts has been appointed to officiate prominent matches, including UEFA Champions League games. For example, he officiated the match between FC Barcelona and BSC Young Boys on October 1, 2024, which ended in a 5-0 victory for the Spanish team. Lambrechts' refereeing style is characterized by consistent enforcement of the rules and effective communication with players, allowing him to maintain control during matches. His experience and professionalism have established him as a respected figure in the European refereeing scene.
